metadata.title: Pravilnik o načinu prikupljanja podataka i načinu prijavljivanja i praćenja neželjenih dejstava ljekova za upotrebu u humanoj medicini
metadata.edition: Službeni list Crne Gore 46/14 (31.10.2014), in force on the eighth day (Article 33) · Article 12: every reaction from Montenegro within 15 days of day 0; follow-up the same period; EU or third-country serious unexpected reactions within 15 days of a request (Montenegrin)
metadata.legal_basis: Rulebook adopted under the Law on Medicines (56/11, 6/13); the official text governs. Status under the 2026 Law on Medicines not read.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
